name: Tailwind CSS
summary: The styling layer the component and dashboard layers assume: every AI component and shadcn-style record emits Tailwind class strings, and the presets speak Tailwind color scales.

steps: V4 with a build step (recommended): npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss, add postcss.config.mjs, and put @import "tailwindcss" at the top of your CSS entry. No tailwind.config.js is needed in v4; theme customization lives in CSS via @theme blocks.
No-build prototype: add the install.cdn script tag to the page head and use Tailwind classes directly in markup. The browser build compiles on the fly and is meant for prototypes only.
V3 projects: tailwind.config.js plus content globs and a PostCSS setup are still the shape. Prefer v4 for anything new.
Then wire a component library on top: the shadcn entry builds directly on this one.

files.role: PostCSS wiring for the Tailwind v4 build
CSS entry: Tailwind v4 needs exactly one @import, no config file
Browser-build Tailwind page the user can open directly, no install at all
files.content: Hello from Tailwind over CDN

notes: The CDN path is for prototypes the user asked for, never for this repo's own pages: the gallery bans remote URLs. The preset layer (design_preset_search) emits raw CSS properties and Tailwind class snippets that drop straight into either setup. For the shadcn theme variables that ride on top of v4, see the shadcn entry's globals.css.
